title: Fund My Musician
tagline: A dapp that allows people to send money as ERC20 to their favorite musicians
description: Fans can purchase FFM Token with Eth and donate them to their favorite musician.  Musician can sell FFM Token for fund.  Musician can upload their music for fans to see. Fan can help promote musician's works by liking their video with FFM Token.  In addition, they can earn FMM by sharing the links of the musician music to their friends and family.
how_its_made: I used React and bootstrap 4 on the front end.  I used firebase to store musician data.  I used solidity to created smart contract for FFM token using ERC20 standard.  I use Pocket Gateway RPC endpoint URL to deploy my contract.  I built this project from scratch.  I did the design using figma.
